derivation.metadata.json / analysis.json / mfu.json: Byte-for-byte copies from the completed run.
derivation.timings.csv: metadata.timings and metadata.medians, joined to mfu.<phase>.end_to_end.
derivation.module_mfu.csv: analysis GR/detailed/<phase>/0 modules, joined to mfu.<phase>; non-matrix FLOPs and MFU are empty.
derivation.launch.csv: Scalar fields from all six analysis NVTX root ranges; launch latency is in microseconds.
derivation.csv_writer: Python standard library csv.DictWriter; full-precision source values.

measurement_boundary: Timing samples were collected with capture disabled inside the nsys process. They are not an independent profiler-free benchmark. Module and launch statistics come from separate captured ranges.
peak_basis: Dense BF16 Tensor Core nominal H200 peak; operator-confirmed H200 configuration reported by the device as NVIDIA H20Z.
